Recon report (read-only, origin/main `0ffe567f9c404cee233d44a6e4ae69a7868590a2)

CLI lifecycle:

- Registration: `crates/callisto-cli/src/cli.rs`
  - `Command`: `add`, `status`, `matrix`, `version`, `pre`, `validate`, `snapshot`, `init`, `plan-publish`, `publish`, `compose-pr-body`, `tag`, `filter-plan`, `release`, `release-pr`, `completions`, `schema`.
  - Release argument types include `ReleasePlanArgs`, `ReleaseInspectArgs`, and release-pr decision/verify/commit-plan args.
- Dispatch modules: `crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/{plan_publish,publish,tag,release,release_pr,filter_plan}.rs`.
- Process execution abstraction: `crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs`, `CliCommandRunner`.

Domain types:

- `crates/callisto-model/src/plan.rs`: `PublishPlan`, `CratePublish`, `NpmPublish`, `NpmMainPublish`, `ReleaseEntry`, `PypiPublish`.
- `crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs`:
  - Decision: `ReleaseDecisionV1`, `ReleaseDecisionEntry`.
  - Inputs: `ReleaseInputSnapshotV1`, `ReleasePackageInputV1`.
  - Operations: `ReleaseOperationRole`, `ReleaseOperationId`, `ReleaseOperation`.
  - Durable state: `ReleaseIntentV1`, `ReleaseExecutionStateV1`, `ReleaseReceiptV1`.
  - Artifacts/attestation: `ArtifactManifestV1`, `ArtifactManifestEntryV1`, `GitHubAttestationPolicyV1`, `GitHubArtifactAttestationV1`.
- `crates/callisto-model/src/release_pr.rs`: `ReleasePrConfigV1`, `ReleasePrSnapshotV2`, `ReleasePrPullRequestV2`, `ReleasePrActionV2`, `ReleasePrDecisionV2`, `ReleasePrCommitPlanV1`.

Graph execution and publishers:

- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs`: `plan_publish`, `filter_plan_by_report`, `PublishOptions`; registry publication ordering and changelog resolution.
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/registry_argv.rs`: `cargo_publish_argv`, `npm_publish_argv`, `pypi_publish_argv`, npm package-manager detection.
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs`: `create_tags`, `create_tags_with_options`.
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_decision.rs`: `derive_release_decision`, `derive_selected_release_decision`, `derive_release_commit_decision`.
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_execution.rs`: `execute_release`, `execute_release_with_artifacts`, `reconcile_release_execution`, artifact-intent matching.
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_store.rs`: `ReleaseStateWriter`, `AtomicReleaseStateWriter`, `ReleaseStateStore`.
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_artifacts.rs`: `verify_artifact_manifest`.

Actions/workflows:

- `.github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml`: release-PR action; delegates to `scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh`.
- `.github/actions/callisto-action/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh`: matrix generation, `callisto release-pr decide/verify`, GitHub ref creation/update/deletion, GraphQL commit-on-branch, tree verification.
- `.github/actions/setup-callisto/action.yml`: resolves `auto`, explicit version tags, or `local`; installs from GitHub Releases/crates.io fallback.
- `.github/actions/setup-callisto-wasm/action.yml`: cache/downloads `callisto-moon.wasm`; fallback builds `callisto-moon` for `wasm32-wasip1` and copies `target/wasm32-wasip1/release/callisto_moon.wasm`.
- `.github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml`: validation and plan-publish preflight.
- `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`: verification gates, release-PR action, release planning from release commit, artifact upload, publication stages.
- `.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml`: formatting, lint, tests, WASM checks, action contract checks.
- `.github/workflows/publish-ci-reports.yml`: downloads and publishes CI reports.

Boundary tests:

- Workflow/pinning contracts: `.github/tests/{verify-action-pins.sh,verify-release-workflow-contract.sh}`.

- Graph tests: `crates/callisto-graph/tests/{publish_tests.rs,publish_target_ecosystem_mismatch_test.rs,plan_version_owner_open_count_test.rs,validate_command_tests.rs}`.

| `ForgeRelease` | `ReleaseOperationId::forge_release` line 927; `ReleaseOperation::forge_release` around line 1005 | Yes, only when `PublishTarget::GitHubRelease`; constructed `release.rs:1090`; prepared operation inserted there | Match at `release.rs:368`; handler `dispatch_forge_release` around line 670 | GitHub API observation through `gh api repos/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}`-style code in `observed_forge_release_target`; creation via `gh release create --verify-tag --generate-notes` lines 690+ | `crates/callisto-cli/tests/durable_release_e2e_tests.rs`; `.github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_github_release_creation.sh`; partial-publish action test |
| `ArtifactUpload { slot }` | `ReleaseOperationId::artifact_upload` line 936; `ReleaseOperation::artifact_upload` around line 1015 | No construction in release-plan production path found. `release.rs` plan builder constructs registry/tag/forge only. | No `PreparedOperation::ArtifactUpload` variant and no executor match/handler. `dispatch_prepared` only handles RegistryPublish, Tag, ForgeRelease | No production observation/dispatch path | Model tests around lines 2304, 2383; graph artifact test around `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_artifacts.rs:221`; execution tests around lines 212+ construct it for validation only |

Additional constructors/usages:

- `ReleaseOperation::new` is used for replacing publish operations with computed prerequisites at `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs:1041`; this preserves the same role and does not introduce a new variant.
- `ReleaseOperation` production construction is confined to `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs:976`, `1054`, and `1090`.
- Other non-production/test construction sites: `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_execution.rs:172-174,212`; `release_store.rs:159`; `release_artifacts.rs:221`; model release tests at 2304, 2383-2384, 2597+, 2722+.

Dispatch coverage:

- `ValidatedReleaseIntent::dispatch_prepared` at `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs:348-371` is the sole production match over prepared operation variants.
- `PreparedOperation` has only `RegistryPublish`, `Tag`, and `ForgeRelease`; no artifact-upload branch exists.
- Role formatting/canonical serialization matches all four roles at `crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs:1483-1490`.
- Canonical operation validation is at `release.rs:1537+`; it validates IDs/order but does not add an executor path for artifact upload.

Tag-name derivation:

- Durable release plan: `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs:1059-1064`, using package `tag_template` or `TagTemplate::default_for(&package.id)`, then `.render(version)`.
- Legacy publish plan: `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs:548`, `idx.template(&pkg.id).render(&ver)`.
- Legacy tag command consumes `ReleaseEntry.tag_name` directly at `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs:25,108+`; floating-major aliases are derived around lines 20-57.
- Tag templates/defaults: `crates/callisto-graph/src/tags.rs:141+`; tests construct/verify names throughout `crates/callisto-graph/tests/tags_tests.rs`.
- CLI renderers display existing names, not derive them: `crates/callisto-cli/src/render/mod.rs:82,171`.
- Action/workflow plans carry serialized `tagName`; shell tests use fixtures such as `pkg@1.0.0` in `.github/actions/callisto-action/tests/*`.

GitHub Release names:

- Durable executor uses the tag itself as the release name/identifier: `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs:670+`, command `gh release create <tag> --verify-tag --generate-notes`.
- Legacy action creates releases from plan `.tagName`: `.github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml` release-entry loop; tested by `test_github_release_creation.sh` and `test_publish_partial_failure_filters_plan.sh`.
- No separate product-name derivation was found; release names are tag strings.

Unconstructed/undispatched model surface:

- `ArtifactUpload` is represented in the model, has constructors and validation tests, but is not constructed by `callisto release plan`, has no `PreparedOperation` counterpart, no executor dispatch branch, and no external observation method.
- All other `ReleaseOperationRole` variants have production plan construction and executor dispatch.
